training.time_scope: Training loop and validation/checkpoint wall time; a current step and final validation/save may finish after the deadline check
training.batching: 8/32-channel buckets, no padding, complete epoch uses each train window once
training.resume: Same run and sealed corpus, saved RNG/optimizer and exact next batch cursor

capacity.shape_order: Alternate true 32-channel and true 8-channel training batches
capacity.selection: Largest tested batch within21GiB with last10 reserved-memory range <=256MiB
capacity.main_initialization: Official checkpoint and fixed fresh seed

objective.mask_selection: Exactly half of channel x one-second patches independently per example; training random, validation fixed by record ID + seed
objective.loss: Mean squared error on masked raw samples only; unmasked target errors excluded
objective.best_selection: Smallest fixed-mask portable validation reconstruction MSE; earliest tie wins; completed epoch or final partial epoch
objective.val_mask_identity: sha256(seed|ssl-validation-mask|record_id), seeded CPU torch.Generator and random permutation

fixed_following_alignment.starting_point: Freeze best SSL encoder and learn fresh projection into the same frozen SmolLM2-1.7B
fixed_following_alignment.input_scale: Same V times1e4 and same resampling as the original frozen CBraMod symbol model
fixed_following_alignment.checkpoint_selection: UniBa validation balanced accuracy, earliest tie wins
fixed_following_alignment.evaluation: Same five conditions on frozen UniBa test and independent ITU external cohort, no test-based tuning
fixed_following_alignment.code_rule: New module and new immutable SSL weights seal; original model source, checkpoints and protocols remain unchanged

actual_post_QC_input.domain_skew: Only three UniBa participants retain eight windows; continuation is overwhelmingly portable-task EEG, not natural coding EEG.
